paragraphs.text: Busjaw was a goblin from the Red Mountains of Oneah , part of the Domains of Dominaria .

Busjaw was sent by his chieftess Kruuna to ask for help from the elves of Savaea . He carried a stone of parlay and wished to speak to the leader of the elves. Intrigued, the elder Leaf agreed to travel to the goblin warrens to parlay with Kruuna. Budjaw was awarded for his efforts with several blows to the head, and a few coins.
